title: Tom's Pocket Money
text:
Tom is twelve years old. He gets three euros of pocket money every week from his grandmother. He likes to buy comics with his money. Sometimes he saves the coins in a jar.

Yesterday, Tom went to the newsagent with his friend Ana. Ana wanted a bag of sweets, but Tom had only one euro left. He bought a small chocolate bar and shared it with her.

questions.text: How much pocket money does Tom get every week?
Why did Tom share the chocolate bar with Ana?
options: He wanted to be kind to his friend
He had to pay his grandmother back

questions.text: What kind of person is Tom most likely?

vocabulary.definition: magazines or books that tell stories with pictures
a small shop that sells newspapers, sweets and drinks
gave part of something to another person to use or eat

paragraph_translations: Tom tiene doce años. Cada semana recibe tres euros de dinero de bolsillo de su abuela. Le gusta comprar cómics con su dinero. A veces guarda las monedas en un bote.
Ayer, Tom fue al quiosco de periódicos con su amiga Ana. Ana quería una bolsa de caramelos, pero a Tom solo le quedaba un euro. Compró una barrita pequeña de chocolate y la compartió con ella.
